title: Stochastic Stability of ACIMs for Piecewise Expanding $C^{1+\varepsilon}$ Maps
summary: We prove stochastic stability of absolutely continuous invariant measures (ACIMs) for piecewise expanding $C^{1+\varepsilon}$ maps of the interval. For maps $τ$ in the class $\mathcal{T}([0,1]; s, \varepsilon)$, we consider perturbed Frobenius--Perron operators $P_δ= Q_δP_τ$, where $Q_δ$ is a Markov smoothing operator modeling noise of intensity $δ> 0$. In the generalized bounded variation space $BV_{1,1/p}$, we establish a Lasota--Yorke inequality uniform in $δ$.
